dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, it can be all rather interesting, yes...

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: Really? I've been going at this thing for hours now, but I just don't get what's so interesting about all this...

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: But since this is something she's into, I'm going to keep trying to get it... And once I finally do, I'll be able to ask her out to the opera house.
